reviews.title: Annoyed
reviews.text: Every time I open the app, the camera doesn’t immediately show up. I have to tap on the screen constantly clicking taking pictures before the camera actually shows up. At this point, I’m just gonna delete the app because it’s not worth the annoyance. It’s too bad because the pictures it takes I do like.

reviews.title: Camera doesn’t open
reviews.text: The camera doesn’t open. I click it to zoom/enhance it, so I can see if it actually is capturing what I need it to capture, but it’s as if I never click the camera option in the app. The only buttons that work are the Lab, actual photo taker button, and flash. Please fix this!!!

reviews.title: Camera

reviews.title: No longer functional :(
reviews.text: I used to love this app but now when I go to the lab to either import photos, select existing ones, etc. none of the buttons work. I don’t know if it’s an incompatibility thing with new iOS updates or what but it’s disappointing because I really loved the app before and had no notes! Just wish I could still use it/ hope they fix the bug issues soon. I’ve tried deleting and redownloading, restarting phone, really everything I could so I don’t think it’s an issue on my end unfortunately. Hope the developers fix this soon so I can leave the five star review the app deserved before it stopped functioning at all

reviews.title: Need a new feature
reviews.text: The app is great i really like it, is simple and the filter is amazing but the fact that the camera is sooo tiny is very annoying and the fact that is basically impossible to take front pictures or selfies makes it even worse, i would use this app a lot if it wasnt for the fact that u cant take any photons on my front camera and i can barely see what ik taking pictures of with my back camera PLEASE CHANGE THISS
